title: Can we all eat together if we book the whole site?

post.title: Can we all eat together if we book the whole site?
post.html: Yes. If you have booked all of the cottages, the games room has a fully equipped kitchen along with tables and chairs to seat every guest, so you can cook and dine together in one place.

description: Yes. If you book every cottage, the games room has a fully equipped kitchen and seating for every guest, so you can all cook and dine together.
